notes: The universe-jpm-h20 cohort with the ADR-0071 cross list bolted on. The SCORED cohort is untouched: tradable and reference are the same five names and SPY, the calendar, the grid geometry and the horizon are byte-identical to universe-jpm-h20.json. What is new is 'cross' - six feature-only funds the split-adjusted store already carries - plus 'market' and 'sector_etf', which say which series the cross block reads for each scored name. A cross symbol builds NO feature frame and NO tape: it is read for its one-minute returns and dropped, so naming these six here costs less memory than leaving them unnamed, because an unnamed store symbol still builds a full frame nobody scores. QQQ is listed so it stops doing that; no column reads it today. The sector map is XLK/AAPL, XLF/JPM, XLV/LLY, XLP/WMT, XLE/XOM, the same pairing the split source was pulled for.

session.notes: Regular hours used to tag rth/eth/closed. Early-close days still end on the tape.

scales.notes: Flipped to cross_session: intra-session it emitted NaN for the first 60 of every 390 RTH minutes, and _frame_matrix drops a row on any non-finite column, so it cost 15.4% of every session forever. Cross-session it costs a one-time warmup. The window now reads back through the overnight gap; at a 5-20 minute horizon this scale is regime context, not a directional claim.
One RTH session of minutes; reads back across the close.
Three RTH sessions; past window only.

horizon.notes: Four leads only: 5, 10, 15, 20 minutes. anchors/se_mult/band_leads are unused by no-information-scan (it walks p-values, not the IC band) and are kept so the object still validates. label_lead is inert here for the same reason.

scan.notes: Ridge, not LightGBM. run-jpm-h20 (A0037) showed train IC 0.10-0.31 against val IC ~0 in all seven folds and an inner-holdout score that carried no information about fold validation - 32 tree combos cannot be ranked on ~1800 rows. Ridge has one knob, tunable on that holdout, and at an achievable R2 near 0.001 there is no budget for the interactions a tree exists to find. Trees return only if ridge clears zero.

holdouts.notes: H/L walk-forward last val 2025-11-30. HPO val Dec 2025–Feb 2026. Untouched from 2026-03-01. CV/HPO documents set test_end_ms=1772323199000 (28 Feb 2026). Backtest after confirm may open through test_b_end_ms. See docs/decisioning/hstar-go.md.
